evidence.observation: 2.938 Torr at growth start, steady ~2.94 through ramp
Rose monotonically to 3.208 Torr (+0.27) with constant Ar flow
MFC reads ~100 sccm, on setpoint, so flow does not explain the pressure rise
Temperature on setpoint at 750 C and heater power stable ~45%, so thermal control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so the growth atmosphere cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or an isolation/rate-of-rise leak check, would tell an air leak (seal_leak) apart from a flow restriction (exhaust_blockage). Pump-side pressure and valve state would also help.
